name: figpress
about: Packages for the figures of scientific papers: figures that go to press as print figures and to the web as interactive ones.

members.name: figpress-plotly
members.purpose: A paper's figures in Plotly: one definition gives the print figure the paper publishes and a matching interactive web figure that can do more.

members.name: figpress-apps
members.purpose: Interactive apps that are the counterparts of a paper's figures, such as globes of viewing directions and linked sky panels, built from the paper's own data and published next to the PDF.
